question: The author of the Hindi novel 'Kohre Mein Kaid Rang' is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Govind Mishra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Govind Mishra is a celebrated Hindi novelist known for his profound literary works.
 
• He was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1998 for his novel "Lal Peeli Zameen".
 
• Govind Mishra has authored more than 50 books, including novels, short stories, and essays.
 
• His writing often explores themes of human struggles and social changes in contemporary India.
 
• "Kohre Mein Kaid Rang" is one of his notable works that reflect his narrative prowess and deep understanding of human emotions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sahitya Akademi Award:**

 
 
• It is a literary honor in India which is awarded annually by Sahitya Akademi, India's National Academy of Letters.
 
• The award recognizes outstanding works of literary merit in the 24 Indian languages recognized by the Akademi.
 
• It was established in 1954 and is one of the most prestigious literary awards in India.
 
• Recipients of the award receive a cash prize and an inscribed copper plaque.
 
 
 
• **Hindi Literature:**
 
 
• Hindi literature has a rich history dating back to the medieval period with works like "Ramcharitmanas" by Tulsidas.
 
• Modern Hindi literature began in the 19th century with the advent of social and literary reforms.
 
• Prominent figures include Munshi Premchand, Mahadevi Verma, and Harivansh Rai Bachchan.
 
• Contemporary Hindi literature continues to evolve, addressing current social issues and changes.
 
 
 
• **Govind Mishra's Contributions:**
 
 
• Besides novels, Govind Mishra has written numerous essays and short stories.
 
• His works have been translated into several Indian languages, broadening their reach and impact.
 
• He has also been involved in literary criticism and has contributed to the academic discourse on Hindi literature.
 
• Govind Mishra's writings often reflect his concern for the marginalized sections of society.
